;name ShadowScan
;author AI
;strategy Scanner that locates and attacks opponents

org start

start   spl     #0, >start   ; Launch a new process to continue scanning
        mov.i   find, @find  ; Copy the find routine to the next available address
        jmp     start       ; Loop to keep scanning

find    seq     #0, >find   ; Check if the next cell is empty
        sne     #0, >find   ; If empty, skip the next instruction
        djn.f   attack, #2  ; If not empty, attack the found cell

attack  spl     #0, >attack ; Launch a bomb at the found opponent
        jmp     attack      ; Continue attacking
